verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec for its Inference API at api-reference/openapi.yaml, plus a second spec for the Dedicated management API, both listed under "OpenAPI Specs" in the docs llms.txt (which a probe confirms is live). The 404 probe only checked other paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.), so it does not contradict the yaml location. missing for 10: an independent or hands-on fetch confirming the openapi.yaml file actually downloads and is valid.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: inference-docs.cerebras.ai publishes the Cerebras Inference API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (server https://api.cerebras.ai, /v1/chat/completions and related endpoints), listed under "## OpenAPI Specs" in the docs llms.txt
